answer: Take the lagoon away and the name goes; take the marble away and the stake goes; take the saffron away and the past goes. Ask for Fresco painter wet-plaster portrait proof brushed onto the chapel wall and the printers fall silent, because each wet-plaster portrait is a season of logged plaster tests plus a signed lime is not a thing a script can conjure. The evidence carries a date, so a proof fired yesterday cannot claim to be a year old. The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 11 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 221 proofs any faster.
